first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Star-filled night sky
entities.identification: A large expanse of cyan-blue sky above the ridge, containing dense star points and a broad pinkish-white to pinkish-purple vertical band of light.

entities.name: Lake surface
entities.identification: The blue water surface in the lower-left portion of the image, at a low point enclosed by the mountains, with point-like and short linear reflections.

entities.name: Ridge encircling the lake
entities.identification: The dark, undulating mountains encircling the lake surface, including the peak line on the far shore and the steep mountain walls descending toward the lake surface.

entities.name: Foreground rocky slope
entities.identification: The rough, dark brown to gray-brown rocky-earth slope extending from the right side of the image to the bottom edge.

entities.name: Evergreen thicket
entities.identification: The clusters of dark trees along the slope edge, on the hilltop, and in the upper-right corner, with narrow, pointed crowns and layered outlines of lateral branches.

entities.name: Foreground dead tree and dead branches
entities.identification: The partially exposed grayish-white to grayish-blue curved, branching trunks and branches near the lower edge of the Foreground rocky slope.
